title: November 2026 Gibraltar Solo
text: Excellent, well-paced trip with delightful informative attentive guides.  Ample free time to explore Gibraltar on our own.
author: christophermM9827OW

title: A Very Worthwhile Trip
text:
The tour was wonderful. It’s a long day, but worth it. We started with Carmela as our guide and she remained with us all day. She was informative, nice and funny. About halfway there we picked up our next guide, Pepe. He was also great. The time on the rock is short, but you have enough time at the stops to see the sights. Please be considerate of the other passengers and be on time when the guides give you a meeting time. Otherwise, the rest of us lose out on time at later stops. There was always someone at one of the stops returning late.

text: Our tour guide was lovely. Catherine she was informative funny and pleasant. Our  driver up the rock. Was funny and made the trip enjoyable. Only comment no toilets on the main coach so had to do toilet stops. Other than that  the tour was very good. As Catherine would say hmm hmmmm 😂
author: brenandjon

title: Great tour
text:
Daniela, our guide, was great, she gave us facts and cool trivia throughout our journey.
She definately showed great dedication and care to everyone on the tour.
From going though the border check to making sure all of us we having a nice time.
Thank you to Daniela, our driver and Loraine.
I had a great time!!!!
author: AnaRosa_N

title: Rock of gibraltar tour
text: I had read mixed reviews so I was a little worried but this tour was fantastic.  There was plenty of time to see everything that I wanted to see and the high point for me was the Macaques. We had plenty of time to spend watching them and taking photos. We had a few different guides and they were all friendly and informative.  I would definitely recommend if you just wanted to see the highlights. There was definitely more to see, and if we had more days in Spain we might have stayed overnight but this was perfect for us. Oh, fun fact. John Lennon and Yoko Ono got married there. That was a bonus
author: Nichole_D

title: Gibraltar all in 10 hours, maybe longer on National holidays...
text:
It is a great experience that is fun too. Carlos and a woman were our guides (primarily the woman). There was a lot to arrange, organize, and keep track of for at least 30 people in our tour. The guides did it all and without breaking a sweat, even on a hot day!
I strongly recommend.

title: Highly recommended
